title: CTOV - Mana and Artifice compatibility
description: Creates MnA Buildings in CTOV villages
body:
This Data Pack is currently NOT part of the core CTOV mod and must be installed to integrate village structures.

 

Add this datapack to the game to add compatibility between CTOV and Mana and Artifice. You will find Manaweaver towers and Runsmith/Runeforge buildings.  This datapack is for Forge only.
